---
title: Billing
description: How usage is measured and invoiced.
editUrl: false
---

Fieldkit bills per **active device per month**. A device is active in a month if it synced at least once in it.

## What Counts

- A device that synced once on the 30th counts for that month.
- A device that was registered and never synced does not count.
- Retired devices never count, even if they synced earlier in the month — they count for the months they synced in.

## Invoices

Invoices are issued on the first working day of the month, for the previous month. They list every active device by name.

## Changing Plans

Upgrades take effect immediately. Downgrades take effect at the end of the billing month, and are refused if the workspace has more devices than the smaller plan allows.
